{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABYZoPew", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhB9jWo", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 86, "title": "Make the new Bullet-backed Ammo WASM the default runtime", "body": "## Problem

PR [#85](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/85) (merged, commit `1f50cba6c0cede6edcfb3e88540bf5e4862bdd4b`) implemented the original [#84](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/84) as an **opt-in comparison**: `?bullet=master` selects the newer official Bullet build while `ammojs-typed@1.1.0` old Bullet remains the default. **This does not satisfy the maintainer's intent.**

The maintainer requests a real switch to the latest official Bullet-backed Ammo.js WASM **as the default**, and plans to personally test stability and MMD motion **after that switch is published**. A/B benchmarking or an engine-selection UI is **not** the goal.

## Expected outcome

Promote the verified, pinned new upstream Bullet WASM build from PR #85 to the **actual default** for the repository's public Examples and main Node/browser regression tests, including Sync, shared Sync and Worker Physics. When the normal Examples load with no query string, they must use the newer Bullet backend, **not** the existing old Ammo build. Keep the old runtime only as a clearly optional rollback/diagnostic fallback; do not silently substitute it while reporting the new engine.

Preserve all physics configuration/behavior except the Bullet backend version: `unitStep=1/60`, `maxStepNum=10`, ERP, damping, constraint frames, collision masks and 60/120 Hz timekeeping. Keep consumer-supplied global Ammo compatibility; the library should not unexpectedly require that all downstream consumers switch.

### Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Confirm the actual current HEAD and PR #85 artifacts/build provenance; use its new pinned official Bullet source or document why a new fixed upstream revision is needed.
- [ ] The default public PMD/PMX Examples (including Gene Light) and Worker Physics page instantiate and use **new Bullet WASM** without any `?bullet=master` override. Verify actual WASM exports/build identity; do not assume a filename proves the backend.
- [ ] Update published asset packaging, default bootstrap and worker `ammoURL`/binary path, README/docs and primary real-Ammo tests to point to the same new Bullet-backed implementation. Existing old Bullet may remain opt-in for rollback, not as the default.
- [ ] Test PMD/PMX, constraints and mode-2 bodies, standalone/shared Sync, Worker transferable/shared memory and Worker fallback. Initialization errors must be explicit; fallbacks must not silently disguise old Bullet as new.
- [ ] Run applicable typecheck, unit/integration/browser tests, locally built Examples and pack/build checks; record executed commands and results. Differences in trajectories due to the new Bullet version are acceptable if documented; unexpected crashes/test failures must be addressed.
- [ ] Document the specific active Bullet commit, how the maintainer can confirm it in the browser, and how to revert the new default if actual-model physics proves worse. Do not require or claim a confirmed fix of intermittent 120 FPS instability.
- [ ] No required old/new benchmarking, A/B UI features, new 1/120 timestep or solver parameter tuning. Avoid unrelated changes.

### Required post-merge verification

- **PENDING until performed:** Check the latest attempt of merge-triggered Pages deployment, deployed SHA, hosted new WASM/JS assets and binary paths/MIME, and ensure that the no-query public Examples actually load the **new** Bullet runtime. This post-merge condition does not block pre-merge approval.
- **PENDING until performed:** Smoke-test public PMD, Gene Light PMX and Worker examples in a real browser; record URL/browser, active Bullet build identity, successful WASM initialization, model startup and controlled physics steps. Keep any unperformed checks pending.
- **Optional maintainer-led follow-up, not a merge blocker:** The maintainer will evaluate real-model visuals and sustained 60/120 Hz stability themselves once the new default is live. Do not mark the rare violent oscillation as fixed without reproduction and evidence.

## Context

- [#84](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/84) / [PR #85](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/85) delivered a pinned newer Bullet build but intentionally left it opt-in.
- Previous WASM-only migration: [#82](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/82) / [PR #83](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/83).
- Official Bullet: https://github.com/bulletphysics/bullet3
